name: Fifteen Hounds
source:
Far in the future, in a different world with which we live today. After the great war, the world split into several factions. Each has a representative who fight each other. Fifteen Hounds tells about 3 teams "Romeo," "Sierra" and "Echo" with the motive of each. But without knowing, there is a mysterious opponent that more formidable aim of destroying them. Like any other visual novel, the story and ending will run depending on the selected team by players.

[ Source: [url=http://doujingravity.blogspot.com.es/2011/05/fifteen-hounds.html]Doujin Gravity[/url] ]
translation:
故事发生在遥远未来，一个与我们今日所处世界不同的地方。大战过后，世界分裂为多个阵营，每个阵营都派出代表相互争斗。《Fifteen Hounds》讲述“Romeo”“Sierra”和“Echo”三支队伍，以及各自的动机。但在他们毫不知情的情况下，一个更加强大的神秘敌人正企图将所有人消灭。与其他视觉小说一样，故事走向与结局将根据玩家选择的队伍而变化。

[来源：[url=http://doujingravity.blogspot.com.es/2011/05/fifteen-hounds.html]Doujin Gravity[/url]]
